info.title: Data Breach Detector MCP
info.description: Read-only breach intelligence from public disclosure feeds: HaveIBeenPwned, the RansomLook leak-site tracker, the frozen ransomwatch archive and SEC 8-K Item 1.05 filings. It reports whether an organization is named in a disclosure, never breach contents. A leak-site listing is a claim, not a confirmed breach.

post.description: Sends Model Context Protocol messages to the hosted Data Breach Detector server over Streamable HTTP. The agent runtime manages the session, so makers do not call this operation directly.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Media types the MCP server may return.
